title: Coverage Remaining after a Driver Addition — Endorsement Deposit Terms, Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Rule.** On the **Installment Payment Plans**, the endorsement deposit taken on an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan has a percentage of the endorsement balance added according to the days that run from the most recent driver addition's change effective date to the owner term's expiration date, the expiration date counted and the change date not:

| Days from the change effective date to the expiration date | Added to the endorsement deposit |
|---|---|
| fewer than 120 | 5 percent of the endorsement balance |
| 120 to 179 | 2.5 percent |
| 180 or more, or no driver added | nothing |

**Records.** The change effective date is read from the driver addition on the Owner Auto Policy term and the expiration date from that Owner Auto Policy term. The most recent driver addition is the one with the latest change effective date; of two on the same date, the one recorded first.

**Counting (hypothetical dates).** A driver added effective 3 March with the term expiring 1 July: the days counted run from 4 March through 1 July, 120 days, so 2.5 percent is added. Had the term expired on 30 June, the count would be 119 days and 5 percent would be added.
